findings.claim: ADR 0029's change is a bullet appended inside Consequences, but okf-bundle.md says a record is never rewritten and a correction is an appended '## Correction, YYYY-MM-DD' section (as in ADR 0006, 0011, 0019). The Decision section still says 'A priority-0 global rule' with nothing next to it pointing at the correction.
Two concepts were edited by hand (components/bifrost, decisions/0029) but no line naming them was appended to .okf/log.md, which the every-touched-concept-is-logged constraint requires.

Two edited lines run past 80 columns. The bifrost.md line ending 'A timeout or classifier error leaves the requested model' and the services.tf comment line ending 'Alphabetical by `provider` -- see' were not rewrapped after the edit.
